source_prompt: Design a coherent proposal for ONE adaptive-duelist milestone boss identity, The Tenth Warden. Treat attached current V01 96x96 placeholder poses as staging/identity continuity references only, NOT final approved costume or lore. One complete pixel-art character, crisp 16-bit-inspired opaque pixels on actual transparent RGBA 96x96 gameplay canvas per pose, consistent head/armor/weapon silhouette and palette across views, same foot baseline, margins and readable action direction. First produce an isolated neutral identity proposal and approve it before making poses. Then separate idle, phase-two, hit, defeat and EXACTLY five move-family poses (two committed close cuts; forward lunge; readable ranged launch without implying parry; broad dodgeable/unblockable sweep; short conditional reposition strike). No invented name, faction symbol, origin, arena art, adds, healing, UI, text, baked telegraph/hit geometry, arbitrary timing or extra moves. Preserve body pose versus warning-overlay separation.
telegraph_prompt: Use accepted existing telegraph_short_arc/lunge_path/projectile_lane/wide_sweep/boss_warning primitives as review candidates, not new images. Only generate new special-case VFX after final runtime hit shapes and motion snapshots prove the existing primitive cannot depict the geometry. Every final VFX must show preparation, active risk, defense semantic and recovery distinctly; no color-only risk distinction; never show projectile-parry or blockable wide sweep.
acceptance_before_closure: Approve boss identity anchor/source and derivative nine poses at 96x96 in native renderer
Approve FINAL five per-move phase-specific timing and exact attack/projectile/actor displacement geometry
Approve each visual primitive placement/scale/rotation/phase duration matched to actual hit area, including Twin Cut two contacts
Test arc volley block/dodge/not-parry and crescent dodge/unblockable visuals; player foreground/weak-point legibility
Bind FINAL inspected resources to five production *.tres only after runtime validation; screenshots or video at true gameplay zoom and reduced-motion checks
